******

### AutoJs6 VSCode development extension

******

* A [VSCode](https://code.visualstudio.com/) extension for debugging and running [AutoJs6](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6) scripts
* Cloned (Clone) from [hyb1996/Auto.js-VSCode-Extension](https://github.com/hyb1996/Auto.js-VSCode-Extension)

******

### Installation (Install)

******

- VSCode menu `View` - `Extensions` `[ Ctrl+Shift+X ]`
- Search for "AutoJs6" or "003"
- Select "AutoJs6 VSCode Extension" and install or update it

******

### Features (Features)

******

- Connect devices in VSCode and manage AutoJs6 scripts or projects (run, stop, save, etc.)
- Display AutoJs6 logs in real time in VSCode
- Connect by QR code and discover devices running server mode on the local network (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
- Pairing confirmation asks before accepting an unknown device, trusts QR-paired devices automatically, and lets you manage trusted devices
- Browse, edit, upload, download and delete device files, run device scripts, and transfer large files in chunks with progress (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
- Pull project changes from a device (device edits -> local files, with per-file diff previews)
- Heartbeats, automatic reconnection and a status-bar device indicator
- A local HTTP command bridge lets external tools invoke extension commands
- Interface text follows the VSCode display language (Simplified Chinese / English), or can be pinned through `autojs6.language`

******

### Usage (Usage)

******

0. Basic operations

- `< Command Palette >`
    - VSCode menu `View` - `Command Palette` `[ Ctrl+Shift+P ]`
- `< Developer Tools >`
    - VSCode menu `Help` - `Toggle Developer Tools`
- `< Menu buttons >`
    - Buttons at the top of the VSCode title area provide quick file/project operations

1. Connect to the computer

- Open `< Command Palette >` and select `AutoJs6: Connect` `[ Ctrl+Alt+F6 ]`, or click the corresponding menu button
- Choose one of the following connection methods
    - `Server | LAN`
        - Enable "Client mode" in the AutoJs6 drawer
        - Enter a local IP address shown by VSCode (the extension listens on `6347`; allow it through the firewall and change it with `autojs6.server.port`)
    - `Server | QR Code`
        - VSCode displays the connection QR code for this computer; you can switch network interfaces
        - In the AutoJs6 (6.8.0+) drawer, select "Client mode" and use the scan button beside the address field to scan the code and connect automatically
    - `Client | LAN`
        - Enable "Server mode" in the AutoJs6 drawer (listening on `7347`)
        - In VSCode, enter the IP address or hostname of the AutoJs6 device, optionally with a port (such as `192.168.1.5:7347` or `[fe80::1]:7347`)
        - After an unexpected disconnect, the extension reconnects automatically with exponential backoff for 5 minutes by default (disable with `autojs6.connection.autoReconnect`); VSCode restores the last connection after restarting (`autojs6.connection.restoreOnStartup`)
        - An explicit disconnect from either side (VSCode commands or the AutoJs6 drawer/manager) stops automatic reconnection
    - `Client | Android Debug Bridge (ADB)`
        - Enable "Server mode" in the AutoJs6 drawer
        - Connect the AutoJs6 device to the computer running VSCode through USB
        - Enable USB debugging on the AutoJs6 device and allow it to trust the computer
        - The procedure varies by device; consult its manufacturer's manual or relevant online documentation
    - `History (IP)`
        - Successful device IP addresses are saved in a selection list
        - Enable "Server mode" in AutoJs6
        - A device's IP address may change
        - Use "Clear" to remove all saved records
- A VSCode message `AutoJs6 device connected: ${DEVICE} (${IP_ADDRESS})` confirms the connection

2. Run commands

- Open `< Command Palette >` to view and run supported commands; shortcuts are listed under "Commands" below
- For example, `AutoJs6: Run` and `AutoJs6: Stop All`
- Some operations also have corresponding menu buttons

3. View logs

- Choose one of the following ways to view logs from AutoJs6
    - Use the `OUTPUT` panel `[ F12 ]` opened after connecting; each device has its own panel
    - Click the `AutoJs6: N` status-bar indicator, select a device and choose "Show logs"
- After disconnection, the panel is retained and marked disconnected by default; `autojs6.log.disposeChannelOnDisconnect` can remove it automatically
- Enable the extension's own debug logs through `autojs6.log.debug`; they appear in `AutoJs6 VSCode Extension Debug`

4. Manage device files (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)

- Click the `AutoJs6` activity-bar icon and browse connected devices' working directories and external storage in "Device Files (Device Files)"
- Click a file to open it in the editor; saving in VSCode writes changes directly back to the device
- Context menus and inline buttons run scripts, create folders/files, upload current or local files, download, rename and delete
- Choose "Upload folders here (Upload Folders)" on a device directory to select multiple local folders. Selected names, subdirectories and empty directories are preserved; existing directories are merged, matching files overwritten, and other device files retained. Uploads show the current path and support cancellation while keeping uploaded content; symlinks and unsupported file types are skipped with a notice
- `AutoJs6: Browse Device Files` adds a device directory to Explorer as a workspace folder

5. Disconnect

- Choose one of the following ways to close all connections between AutoJs6 and VSCode
    - Open `< Command Palette >` and select `AutoJs6: Disconnect All` `[ Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F6 ]`
    - Turn off the relevant client/server switch in the AutoJs6 drawer
    - Disconnect the USB connection of AutoJs6 (only for ADB (USB) connections)
    - Exit the AutoJs6 app or close VSCode

******

### Commands (Commands)

******

- View online documentation (View Online Document) `[ Alt+Shift+F6 ]`
    - Open the AutoJs6 online developer documentation
- Connect a device (Connect) `[ Ctrl+Alt+F6 ]`
    - Connect AutoJs6 and VSCode
    - The relevant AutoJs6 switches may need manual enablement
- Show connection QR code (Show QR Code) `[ CTRL+ALT+6 Q ]`
    - Show a QR code for the AutoJs6 client mode to scan
- Disconnect all (Disconnect All) `[ Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F6 ]`
    - Close every established connection
    - The relevant AutoJs6 switches may be reset
- Disconnect a device (Disconnect Device)
    - Select the device to disconnect
- Reconnect the last device (Reconnect)
    - Retry a reconnecting target immediately, or restore the last successful LAN/ADB connection
- Stop automatic reconnection (Cancel Reconnect)
    - Stop all ongoing automatic-reconnection sessions
- Pull project changes from a device (Pull Project from Device)
    - Compare the device copy with the local project, select new/modified device files to pull, and preview each diff
- Manage trusted devices (Manage Trusted Devices)
    - View and remove trusted AutoJs6 devices; a removed device requires confirmation the next time it connects
- Select a device (Select Device)
    - List connected devices and choose an action (logs, run, save, browse files or disconnect), also available through the status-bar indicator
- Run script (Run) `[ F6 ]`
    - Run the script corresponding to the current VSCode
    - Applies to all connected devices
- Rerun script (Rerun)
    - Stop and rerun the script corresponding to the current VSCode
    - Applies to all connected devices
- Stop current script (Stop) `[ Ctrl+F6 ]`
    - Stop the script corresponding to the current VSCode
    - Applies to all connected devices
- Stop all scripts (Stop All) `[ Ctrl+Shift+F6 ]`
    - Stop all running scripts
    - Applies to all connected devices
- Save to all devices (Save)
    - Save the current file to the AutoJs6 working directory of connected devices
    - Applies to all connected devices
- Run on a selected device (Run On Device)
    - Open the device menu and choose where to run the script corresponding to VSCode
- Save to a selected device (Save To Device)
    - Open the device menu and choose where to save the script corresponding to VSCode
- New project (New Project) `[ CTRL+ALT+6 N ]`
    - Select an empty folder, creating one if needed, for a new AutoJs6 project
    - After creating a project, run `npm run dts-link` or `npm run dts` to deploy declarations
- Run project (Run Project) `[ CTRL+ALT+6 R / Alt+F6 ]`
    - Run an AutoJs6 project
- Save project to device (Save Project) `[ CTRL+ALT+6 S ]`
    - Save an AutoJs6 project incrementally; propagating file deletions to the device requires AutoJs6 6.8.0+
- Resynchronize the entire project (Resync Project)
    - Send every project file to the device and overwrite matching files
- Browse device files (Browse Device Files)
    - Add a device directory to Explorer as a workspace folder (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)

******

### Settings (Settings)

******

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `autojs6.language` | `auto` | Interface language: `auto` follows the VSCode display language; `en` or `zh-cn` pins it. Command titles and setting descriptions always follow VSCode; reload the window to apply every change |
| `autojs6.server.port` | `6347` | Extension listening port, used by AutoJs6 client mode |
| `autojs6.server.confirmUnknownDevices` | `true` | Ask before accepting an unknown client-mode device; QR-paired or previously allowed-and-remembered devices need no confirmation |
| `autojs6.client.port` | `7347` | Default port for AutoJs6 server mode |
| `autojs6.http.enabled` / `autojs6.http.host` / `autojs6.http.port` | `true` / `127.0.0.1` / `10347` | Local HTTP command bridge, for example `http://127.0.0.1:10347/exec?cmd=run&path=...` |
| `autojs6.adb.path` | Empty | Path to the adb executable or its directory; an empty value enables autodetection |
| `autojs6.discovery.enabled` | `true` | Discover AutoJs6 6.8.0+ devices running server mode through mDNS (`_autojs6._tcp`) when connecting over LAN |
| `autojs6.connection.connectTimeout` / `handshakeTimeout` | `8000` / `6000` | Connection and handshake timeouts in milliseconds |
| `autojs6.connection.heartbeatInterval` / `heartbeatTimeout` | `15000` / `10000` | Heartbeat interval and timeout in milliseconds; interval 0 disables heartbeats |
| `autojs6.connection.autoReconnect` / `maxReconnectAttempts` | `true` / `0` | Reconnect unexpected disconnections of extension-initiated connections; 0 attempts means unlimited |
| `autojs6.connection.reconnectTimeout` / `reconnectMaxDelay` | `300` / `10000` | Reconnection-session window in seconds (0 means unlimited) and maximum backoff in milliseconds |
| `autojs6.connection.restoreOnStartup` | `true` | Restore the last successful device connection at VSCode startup, except explicit disconnections |
| `autojs6.log.showChannelOnConnect` | `true` | Show the log panel automatically when a device connects |
| `autojs6.log.disposeChannelOnDisconnect` | `false` | Remove the log panel when a device disconnects |
| `autojs6.log.debug` | `false` | Record extension debug logs |
| `autojs6.save.keepRelativePath` | `true` | Preserve workspace-relative directories when saving files (AutoJs6 6.8.0+) |

See [protocol.md](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-VSCode-Extension/blob/master/protocol.md) for the communication protocol.

## Changelog

### v1.1.0

###### 2026/09/16

* `Feature` The "AutoJs6" activity-bar view contains a "Devices (Devices)" list and "Device Files (Device Files)" tree for browsing, opening, editing, uploading, downloading, renaming and deleting device files and running scripts (requires AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
* `Feature` Upload multiple local folders from the device-files view, preserving subdirectories and empty directories, merging matching directories and overwriting matching files, with progress and cancellation
* `Feature` The `autojs6fs://` remote filesystem opens device files directly in the editor and saves them back; "Browse Device Files" adds a device directory to the workspace
* `Feature` QR connections: "Server | QR Code" displays this computer's connection code, and AutoJs6 6.8.0+ client mode connects after scanning _[`issue #12`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/12)_
* `Feature` Protocol v2: application-level heartbeats (ping/pong) detect half-open connections; extension-initiated LAN/ADB connections reconnect after unexpected disconnection _[`issue #3`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/3)_ _[`issue #13`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/13)_
* `Feature` Reconnection sessions use exponential backoff after unexpected disconnection, for 5 minutes by default with configurable attempts/window/maximum interval; VSCode restores the last connection after restarting (`autojs6.connection.restoreOnStartup`). Add "Reconnect last device (Reconnect)" and "Stop automatic reconnection (Cancel Reconnect)", with status-bar progress
* `Feature` Disconnection notice `bye`: either side informs the peer of explicit disconnection, preventing reconnection and startup restoration; VSCode sends `bye(shutdown)` on shutdown so AutoJs6 (6.8.0+) can reconnect later
* `Feature` Pairing confirmation offers "Allow and remember / Allow once / Deny" for unknown client-mode devices; QR connections use a one-time token for automatic trust. Add "Manage trusted devices (Manage Trusted Devices)" and `autojs6.server.confirmUnknownDevices`; AutoJs6 6.8.0+ shows "Waiting for VSCode confirmation"
* `Feature` LAN discovery (mDNS): "Client | LAN" automatically lists AutoJs6 6.8.0+ devices with server mode and LAN discovery enabled; disable with `autojs6.discovery.enabled`
* `Feature` Large transfers split reads/writes exceeding 1 MiB into 1 MiB chunks, with cancellable progress (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
* `Feature` "Pull project changes from device (Pull Project from Device)" compares the device copy to the local project, lists added/modified files, previews per-file diffs and pulls selected changes (AutoJs6 6.8.0+ compares `md5` from `fs.list`; older versions compare contents)
* `Feature` Localization follows the VSCode display language (Simplified Chinese / English), including command titles and setting descriptions (vscode.l10n)
* `Feature` Status-bar device indicator for quickly selecting run, save, logs or disconnect actions
* `Feature` Settings (`autojs6.*`) cover listening ports, HTTP command-service address/port, adb path, connection/handshake/heartbeat timeouts, reconnection, log panels and relative save paths
* `Feature` Connection addresses accept hostnames and custom ports (`host:port`, `[ipv6]:port`) _[`issue #20`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/20)_
* `Feature` "Resynchronize entire project (Resync Project)" forces a complete overwrite of the device project _[`issue #29`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/29)_
* `Fix` Fix activation failures when port 6347/10347 is occupied, such as with multiple VSCode windows, causing all commands to report "not found" _[`issue #14`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/14)_ _[`issue #15`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/15)_
* `Fix` Fix device discovery on Linux / macOS when parsing `adb devices` with Windows line endings; add adb autodetection (`ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, common installation paths) and `autojs6.adb.path` _[`issue #35`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/35)_
* `Fix` Fix the inverted `override` flag during incremental sync and failed device deletion when `deletedFiles` contains backslashes on Windows (requires matching AutoJs6 6.8.0+) _[`issue #29`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/29)_
* `Fix` Fix "Stop current script" and "Save" selecting the wrong editor when focus is in the output panel
* `Fix` Fix exceptions from accessing disposed connections after handshake timeout or disconnection
* `Fix` Handle output panels after device disconnection: retain and mark them disconnected by default, or remove automatically with `autojs6.log.disposeChannelOnDisconnect` _[`issue #30`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/30)_
* `Fix` Remove port forwarding when an ADB connection closes
* `Fix` Fix occasional false "Cannot reconnect ..., stopped retrying" messages after unexpected disconnection (previously stopped after 5 attempts, about 31 s); show failure once at the end of the reconnection window with "Retry" / "Do not restore automatically"
* `Improvement` Include workspace-relative paths when saving/running files; AutoJs6 6.8.0+ preserves the directory structure in its working directory _[`issue #37`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/37)_
* `Improvement` The HTTP command service listens only on `127.0.0.1` by default (previously `0.0.0.0`), preventing other LAN hosts from invoking local commands
* `Improvement` Filter virtual interfaces such as Hyper-V / VirtualBox / Docker / WSL, and prioritize the default-gateway interface _[`issue #12`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/12)_
* `Improvement` Reduce QR-code density through a shorter payload and lower error correction, and add a size slider to help AutoJs6 focus when scanning
* `Improvement` Skip `ignore` directories such as `node_modules` directly during project traversal and remove full-package byte debug dumps
* `Improvement` Separate protocol/device/UI/remote-file/QR modules and add pure Node.js unit tests (`npm test`)
* `Improvement` Bundle with esbuild, reducing vsix from 9.6 MB to about 1 MB; replace `pinyin` / `systeminformation` with `tiny-pinyin` and system routing-table discovery
* `Improvement` Add port explanations and the `protocol.md` protocol document to README _[`issue #10`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/10)_

### v1.0.13

###### 2026/03/14

* `Improvement` Refactor device-side Socket framing: replace text headers with a fixed 8-byte binary header (int32BE length + type)
* `Improvement` Parse TCP streams with a cumulative-buffer frame loop for reliable partial and concatenated frames
* `Improvement` Validate frame types and maximum lengths to detect protocol desynchronization early and prevent abnormal memory growth
* `Improvement` Remove unnecessary string intermediates when sending JSON and binary data

### v1.0.12

###### 2025/04/14

* `Fix` Fix server-mode connection failures caused by incorrect version checks _[`issue #27`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/27)_
* `Improvement` New projects can use the `dts-link` script task to create a symlink to [AutoJs6 declarations](http://dts-project.autojs6.com/) automatically _[`issue #8`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/8)_

## Multilingual documentation

Edit the language JSON and templates in `.readme/` and `.changelog/`, then regenerate the documents. Do not edit generated Markdown directly. The root README uses Simplified Chinese. These commands require Python 3.10 or newer without extra Python packages; Windows can use `py` instead of `python`. `--check` validates languages, fields, historical versions and dates, punctuation, and generated files without writing. CI runs the same check.

```shell
python .python/generate_markdown.py
python .python/generate_markdown.py --check
python -m unittest discover -s .python/tests
```
